title: test_presence_resource.py: Resource leak - client context not shut down
description: Line 152: test_purge_no_stale_returns_zero calls _setup() which creates both client and server contexts, but discards the client with `_, server, presence = await _setup()`. The finally block only calls `await server.shutdown()`, leaving the client aiocoap.Context unclosed. This could cause resource warnings or test interference. Fix: capture the client and call `await client.shutdown()` in the finally block.
